scope: Independent source review and readback of focused host-JDK/Node fixture reports. No actual Android WebView/media decoder, emulator, phone playback or gameplay was run.
observations: Native route positions only once at the assigned track start and bounds the complete track. Range requests are rejected; fetch explicitly requests a complete200response withoutRange.
Player validates immutable cataloglength/status before constructing an audioBlobURL. Subsequent media seek/loop operates inside the Blob, not the intercepted pack stream.
Fetch,play and buffering deadlines remain bounded; repeatedwaiting cannot extend one deadline. ExplicitOn replaces a loading/pending attempt and leaves healthyplay alone.
Off,hidden/background,newtrack and disposal abort pending IO,clear deadlines,detach media and revoke anyBlobURL. Generation/allowed guards prevent late completion from restoring abandoned playback.
Native music flag, soundeffects controls, assignments, downloadpack metadata and retained Duel loader suffix are unchanged.
